dialogues.speaker: Sevigne
dialogues.text: Objectively speaking, the Icewind Suite is of less commercial value than Fonta. After all, the original proposal came from Mr. Bossuet...

dialogues.speaker: Sevigne
dialogues.text: Mr. Maillardet took it over and then added his own color... But if you ask me, the undertaking is much like the man himself. How to put it kindly? There's room for development?
